page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening, single column of text with a table); margin notes in the right margin (three small notes beside the table); no footer text beyond the page number at top right.

main_text.p: Exempli gratia: Si Kebia Thisri in anno Communi abundanti fuerit 5. neomenia sequentis Nisan erit feria 1. quia 5. & 3. componunt feriam primam. In anno Embol. abundanti esset feria 3. quoniam 5. & 5. faciunt feriam tertiam.
main_text.head: Exemplum reliquorum mensium.
main_text.p: In proxime praecedenti cyclo decemnovennali annus tertius est Embolimaeus abundans. Caput ejus in 30. Augusti. quare tres primi menses sunt pleni.
Sequitur aliud exemplum anni in cyclo praecedenti decimi sexti, qui est annus communis deficiens.

page.notes: Right margin notes, as printed: "Ann 1638 cycloSolis 23. lit. Dom. G" and "Ann 1639". Several faint ghost-printed lines from the reverse page show through and are omitted. Table digits and Roman numerals are copied as far as legible; the Hebrew month names are transliterated as printed. Dense show-through on the page; some table entries may be imperfect.
